{
  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "DCAT-US 3 defines four property requirement levels (mandatory/recommended/optional/deprecated) with RFC 2119 keyword semantics, defines what 'processing' means for receivers, lists the table notations used per property (Property, URI, Range, ReqLevel, Card, Usage note, CV), and introduces a property-evolution change-type table."
  },
  "concepts": [
    {
      "id": "c1",
      "name": "requirement levels",
      "aliases": ["Requirement level", "ReqLevel"],
      "description": "The four levels DCAT-US assigns to properties, stating what a receiver and a sender must, should, or may do with the information for that property.",
      "anchor": "defines four requirement levels",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "c2",
      "name": "Property Evolution in DCAT-US 3.0.",
      "aliases": ["property evolution", "change types"],
      "description": "The categorized types of change and update within the DCAT-US specifications, used to track how the data catalog standard evolved.",
      "anchor": "Property Evolution in DCAT-US 3.0.",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    }
  ],
  "definitions": [
    {
      "id": "d1",
      "term": "Mandatory property",
      "verbatim_text": "a receiver MUST be able to process the information for that property; a sender MUST provide the information for that property.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "Mandatory property",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "d2",
      "term": "Recommended property",
      "verbatim_text": "a receiver MUST be able to process the information for that property; a sender SHOULD provide the information for that property if it is available.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "Recommended property",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "d3",
      "term": "Optional property",
      "verbatim_text": "a receiver MUST be able to process the information for that property; a sender MAY provide the information for that property but is not obliged to do so.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "Optional property",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "d4",
      "term": "Deprecated property",
      "verbatim_text": "a receiver SHOULD be able to process information about instances of that property; a sender SHOULD NOT provide the information about instances of that property.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "Deprecated property",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "d5",
      "term": "processing",
      "verbatim_text": "the term \"processing\" means that receivers MUST accept incoming data",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "term \"processing\" means",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "d6",
      "term": "ReqLevel",
      "verbatim_text": "denotes whether the class / property is mandatory, recommended or optional.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "ReqLevel",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "d7",
      "term": "Card",
      "verbatim_text": "specifies the minimum number of values that MUST be provided for that property and the maximum number of values that MAY be provided.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "(\"Cardinality\")",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    },
    {
      "id": "d8",
      "term": "CV",
      "verbatim_text": "defines which controlled vocabulary SHOULD be used.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "(\"Controlled Vocabulary\")",
      "location": "dcat-us-3-candidate-recommendation-snapshot#c0009"
    }
